entities.name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase 1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed mammalian UniProt references; identified as mitochondrial pyruvate dehydrogenase [acetyl-transferring]-phosphatase 1, EC 3.1.3.43.
Dephosphorylates and reactivates the E1 alpha subunit of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex; PP2C domain detected at residues 203–441.

entities.name: PDH E1α dephosphorylation
observations: O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + H2O → L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + phosphate (Rhea:12669; EC 3.1.3.43).

entities.name: Mg2+
observations: Curated reference annotation reports Mg2+ binding; Mn2+ can substitute for catalytic activity.
